issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Make "Click Ten" as a tiny web game played in the browser: one page with a button and a counter; each click adds one, and at ten clicks the game shows "You did it!" and a button to play again, which resets the counter to zero.

One HTML file with its script and style inside it; no images, sound or libraries.

issue.author: qa
issue.body:
Standard I accept against (from objective #1):
- Single HTML file, inline script/style; no images, sound, libraries, external requests.
- One page: a button and a counter starting at 0; each click adds exactly one.
- At 10 clicks: shows 'You did it!' and a play-again button; click-button no longer increments past 10.
- Play again resets counter to 0 and returns to initial state; repeatable.
I will play it in headless Chromium (Playwright) at each PR head, report reproducible defects to game-developer, and approve release/final only when all hold and playtester has reported.
issue.title: QA commitment: accept Click Ten
